headline: A 2014 law updated the federal charter of the Veterans of Foreign Wars to include women veterans and to cover surviving spouses, not only widows.
what_it_does: The law changes the wording of the federal charter that governs the Veterans of Foreign Wars. It describes the group as a national association of veterans, including women, instead of an association of men. It also expands the group's purpose from helping widows to helping surviving spouses.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 4, 2014.
